argv: set -e; rootdev=$(awk '$2=="/mnt/debian" {print $1}' /proc/mounts); case "$rootdev" in /dev/block/mmcblk*p*) ;; *) exit 1;; esac; umount /mnt/debian; mount -t ext4 -o rw "$rootdev" /mnt/debian; test "$(cat /mnt/debian/etc/machine-id)" = 3c2a1b8f2d624db4b5ffdc836050fcf6; grep ' /mnt/debian ' /proc/mounts
